originalPrompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE isolated upright arched storybook doorway for an interactive book-selection prototype. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE: match its rich colored-pencil, fine ink, worn warm parchment arch, chipped painted timber, antique brass details, handmade pop-up-book charm. Render front-facing, nearly orthographic, door open outward to the left about 65 degrees, entire arch and door visible. Portrait composition, doorway fills canvas with small transparent margin. Ground is only a very narrow parchment sill, NO book, NO surrounding room, NO text or labels, NO characters. Actual transparent outside background, artwork inside the doorway is opaque. Similar proportions and baseline for a set of three. Weathered teal wooden door with a brass gear emblem. Through the arch: cozy kid inventor's garage workshop, salvaged mechanical parts and copper wiring on a bench, small blue power core, amber work light, ordinary neighborhood visible beyond. No castles, no invented hero or robot character.
